- Server prerendering for fast first paint → then WebAssembly takes over for snappy client-side interaction with no server round-trips

| `Models/Shipment.cs` | Shared domain model with status enum |
| `Data/ShipmentDbContext.cs` | EF Core context (SQLite) |
| `Services/ShipmentSeeder.cs` | Seeds 6 sample shipments |

- ✅ Dispatchers: full shipment list with status, destination, filtering, create/update
- ✅ Customers: tracking lookup with status + estimated delivery + progress bar
- ✅ Worldwide latency: WebAssembly runs locally after initial load — no round-trips
- ✅ Fast first visit: server-side prerendering delivers HTML immediately
- ✅ Interactive controls: every page has forms, filters, dropdowns, or buttons
- ✅ Individual accounts: ASP.NET Core Identity with `[Authorize]` on all endpoints
